verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rippling has APIs, developer documentation, a CLI for building Rippling-hosted integrations, and internal custom workflows, such as notifying people or automating a Slack alert. None of it documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks for payroll processed, employee onboarded or payment failed events. Internal workflows, chat alerts and API building blocks are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for a webhooks story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payroll lifecycle events (payroll processed, employee onboarded, payment failed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations
